text: 从应援娃娃租赁到定制妆造：时代少年团演唱会如何撬动消费链条 2026 年时代少年团上海站演唱会通过拉动住宿、餐饮及衍生品等多元消费，有效发挥了“票根经济”对文商旅体展融合发展的促进作用。
text_en: From fan support doll rentals to custom styling: How Times Youth League concerts drive the consumption chain—the 2026 Shanghai concerts boosted accommodation, dining, and derivative consumption, effectively leveraging the 'ticket-stub economy' to promote integrated development of culture, commerce, tourism, sports, and exhibitions
